thread:
alex_cs: Day0 check-in for Copperfield private deploy — want to make sure we have short answers on network paths, IAM bootstrap, KMS CMEK policy, and where audit logs land. Any obvious renewal/expiry risks we should surface now?

sam_netops: quick status — VPC & subnets created, peering with customer transit is up but route propagation needs validation on their side. NSGs applied, but NAT gateway sizing TBD.

alex_cs: @sam_netops can you confirm whether flow logs are enabled and where they're shipped? customer asked for 90d retention and SIEM ingestion.

sam_netops: flow logs enabled to priv-logs-bucket in their account (S3). We're currently writing uncompressed JSON. I'll add lifecycle rule for 90d. For SIEM, we recommend forwarding via a collector (they requested Splunk).

maria_security: KMS: customer wants a customer-managed CMK with rotation every 90 days and separate key for audit-s3-envelope encryption. Current policy draft blocks cross-account decrypt except our ops-role. Need their canonical AWS account id to finish key policy.

jules_eng: for IAM bootstrap we have a minimal service principal and temp role for onboarding agents. Service role example:
```
RoleName: redwood-onboard-agent
AssumeRolePolicy: {"Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"}
Policies: ["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject","kms:Encrypt"]
```
We should avoid giving kms:Decrypt to the agent role — only our ops-role and their security team get decrypt.

alex_cs: noted. Also customer flagged audit log schema — they want envelope fields: request_id, model_version, prompt_hash, and retention tags. Are we able to add those from the agent side before forwarding?

jules_eng: yes — agent will add metadata to the envelope. We'll need a small config change (two-line YAML) on their collector. I'll drop the config snippet into the runbook.

onboard-bot: Runbook created: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/copperfield/day0-governance (private link) :white_check_mark:

maria_security: renewal risk: the customer's KMS CMK is set to manual rotation today. If they don't accept auto-rotation in 30 days we'll have to schedule a key rollover playbook — that adds ~3 days of freeze window for re-encrypting artifacts. Marking as "medium" risk.

alex_cs: action items: 1) @sam_netops confirm SIEM forwarding method and lifecycle rule (due EOD PT). 2) @maria_security finalize key policy with customer's account id (due tomorrow). 3) @jules_eng add envelope config to runbook + sample IAM policy (due EOD). I'll do a short enablement call tomorrow 10am PT.

sam_netops: ack, will confirm SIEM path and add lifecycle rule by EOD. :thumbsup:

maria_security: ack, will ping the customer for account id and post policy diff in the runbook.

jules_eng: adding config & policy now, will link once pushed.

alex_cs: thanks team — I'll capture these in the weekly health note and flag the key-rotation risk for renewals.

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: enablement-call with Copperfield 2026-03-23T10:00:00Z (calendar invite sent)
